title: Watching my Reinforcement Learning Trading Agent lose simulated money on micro-ticks (We built a Go/Python SDK to fix this chaos) 📉🤖
author: Accomplished-Car8427

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
The number I would check first is what a round trip costs inside your sim. An agent that opens and closes on every micro tick and still ends up only modestly down is usually telling you the fee and spread model is too kind, and RL is very good at finding that gap and living in it.

Worth putting the full cost inside the reward rather than subtracting it at the end, because otherwise the policy never learns that trading is expensive. What are you charging it per fill right now?

replies.body: I'll keep it in the thread rather than DMs. Still curious what you're charging it per fill though. If the sim bills nothing per round trip, a micro-tick policy looks like it's bleeding slowly when it's really just paying costs the reward function never showed it.
